thread.title: DigiTimes: 70-75M iPhones could ship by year's end - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: DigiTimes: 70-75M iPhones could ship by year's end - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) iPhone shipments are expected to reach 70M to 75M by year’s end, according to DigiTimes industry sources .
Apple is expected to release three new iPhones next month: two OLED models (5.8-inch and 6.5-inch) and a 6.1-inch LCD model.
Supply partners TSMC ( TSM +2.2% ) and Foxconn/Hon Hai ( OTCPK:HNHAF , OTCPK:HNHAY ) could hit new highs in Q4.
Apple shares are up 1.1% to $220.30.
